drawerCases.name: param_off
drawerCases.note: the block is always shown; no card tip lines, nothing taken off

drawerCases.name: exactly_enough
drawerCases.note: available == card tips: all paid, drawer at zero, not short

drawerCases.name: short_partial
drawerCases.note: pays only what is there; remainder owed to staff; drawer never below zero

drawerCases.name: short_negative
drawerCases.note: pays everything; drawer below zero, shown in red with the shortfall

drawerCases.name: ask_no_choice_yet
drawerCases.note: an X before the close: previewed as partial, the close must ask

drawerCases.name: ask_not_short
drawerCases.note: enough cash: no question, frozen as partial

drawerCases.name: zero_card_tips
drawerCases.note: parameter on with no card tips: both tip lines show 0.00

drawerCases.name: already_negative_before_tips
drawerCases.note: partial pays nothing when the drawer is already below zero

drawerCases.name: z_movements_excluded_with_between
drawerCases.note: a Z without cashDrawer.zExpectedCashMovements: no movement lines, between-shift line shown

drawerCases.name: blind_count_hidden
drawerCases.note: expected cash hidden: no total / short lines; tip lines stay

tillTableCases.name: shop3_one_short_partial
tillTableCases.note: one till's cash never pays another till's tips

tillTableCases.name: area2_cash_tips_and_unpaid
tillTableCases.note: summary: total cash before payouts − (cash tips + card tips paid) − unpaid = business cash

tillTableCases.name: area2_net_negative
tillTableCases.note: net below zero: staff are owed more than the drawers hold

tillTableCases.name: shop2_all_off
tillTableCases.note: no till froze the parameter: paid/unpaid columns null, unpaidTotal 0.00
